Title: Vikram's Day

Cast

1. Vikram - 36 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Sonali - 60 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Sanjay - 28 years, friend
Look: moustache, checked shirt
4. Anjali - 34 years, friend
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
5. Meenakshi - 31 years, daughter
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The office - desks, computers, a glass wall

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Vikram stands by the road. Sonali, Sanjay and Meenakshi stand near him.]

Sonali: "Today feels like a good day."

[Vikram rides his motorbike to the market.]

Sonali: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Vikram drives the car to the office.]

Sanjay (gently): "What happened?"

[Vikram takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Sanjay: "Hmm, I see."

[Vikram withdraws cash from the ATM.]

Meenakshi (softly): "Hmm, I see."

[Vikram counts the notes and puts them in his wallet.]

Vikram (laughing): "And then?"

Scene 2: The office - Day

[Vikram stands in the office. Sonali and Sanjay stand near him.]

Vikram: "So, here we are!"

[Vikram clutches his chest, collapses with a heart attack and dies.]

Sonali (surprised): "We have to be strong now."
